subject: Request: latest external penetration test & secure transfer options
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme-corp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: sec-ops@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: latest external penetration test & secure transfer options

Hi Vivek,

Hope you’re well. Acme’s InfoSec team is preparing for a Q2 supplier assessment and has asked for the most recent external penetration test report that covers Redwood’s hosted API offering (including public API endpoints and the managed key handling flow). Could you share the latest PDF, or advise the secure channels you support for transferring this material?

Specifically we need to know:
- Whether the report covers the hosted API surface (public endpoints + auth flows).
- If you can provide a redacted copy vs. the full report and what redaction policy you apply.
- Available transfer mechanisms (time-limited S3 presigned link, access-controlled file share, secure data room).
- Any paperwork needed (NDA, DPA amendment, evidence acceptance form).

Our timeline is tight — it would help if we can get a redacted copy or pointer to the summary within 48 hours. If a presigned link is the fastest route, please note we prefer IP-restricted links or a short-lived URL.

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Security Program Manager
Acme Corp

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest external penetration test & secure transfer options

Hi Maria — thanks for the note and the timeline. Looping in Laura (Security) and Ben (Account) to coordinate delivery.

Short answers up front:
- Scope: our most recent external pen test (Nov 2025) covers the hosted API surface (public endpoints, auth, and the hosted API control plane). It does not include customer-managed on-prem installers.
- Redaction: we can provide a redacted PDF suitable for customer reviews; the redaction removes exploit PoCs and specific external vendor IPs per our disclosure policy.
- Transfer options: the fastest is a time-limited S3 presigned link with optional IP restriction (24–72 hrs). We can also upload to a secure data room (Link) or use an enterprise file share (ShareFile/Box) with ACLs.
- Paperwork: for a full unredacted report we require an NDA addendum; for redacted reports we typically only need an evidence acceptance confirmation from your side.

Laura — can you confirm the redaction level we can release to Acme and attach the small checklist we share internally? Ben — I’ll let you drive timing/ack. Maria — if you can confirm the list of recipients and whether you need IP restriction, we’ll push the link.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest external penetration test & secure transfer options

Hi all — quick security note on the release options.

We can proceed with a customer-facing redacted PDF that removes:
- Any exploit payloads or step-by-step PoC content
- Internal IP addresses and third-party tester contact information
- Vendor internal ticket IDs and any material flagged under non-disclosure clauses

The redacted copy is normally sufficient for procurement/security reviews. If Acme requires the unredacted report, the next steps are:
1) Execute a limited-scope NDA addendum (I can provide a template).
2) We record an access request and log the recipient emails.
3) Provide the file via our private S3 bucket using a presigned URL — we can enforce: time-window (24/72 hrs), maximum downloads, and optional IP whitelisting.

I’ve attached our internal checklist and a short instruction file for requesting an S3 presign (s3-presigner-instructions.txt). If you confirm recipient emails and IPs, we’ll provision the link.

-Laura Bennett
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: s3-presigner-instructions.txt (instructions, fields required: requester, recipients, justification, IP whitelist)
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme-corp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: sec-ops@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest external penetration test & secure transfer options

Thanks Vivek and Laura — that all sounds good. A couple of clarifications from our side:
1) We prefer a presigned link (time-limited + IP restriction). Please restrict to our corporate IP block: 198.51.100.0/24.
2) Recipients: maria.gomez@acme-corp.com, sec-ops@acme-corp.com, and one external consultant (consultant@security-partner.io).
3) Please confirm the redaction level and whether the report explicitly lists the tested endpoints (we need to confirm hosted API coverage to our reviewers).

If you can deliver the redacted PDF via presigned link with those IP and recipient constraints, that should satisfy our audit team. Target timeframe: within 48 hours if possible.

Regards,
Maria

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest external penetration test & secure transfer options

Thanks — that’s clear, Maria. Next steps from Redwood:

1) Authorization: Laura has approved a customer-facing redacted PDF that includes an appendix listing the tested endpoints (high level: hosted API control plane, public API endpoints, OAuth/JWT auth flows). The redaction removes PoCs and identifying vendor notes.

2) Presigned link: Ben will submit an S3 presign request with the following constraints: recipients (maria.gomez@acme-corp.com, sec-ops@acme-corp.com, consultant@security-partner.io), IP whitelist 198.51.100.0/24, expiration 48 hours, max downloads 3.

3) Attachments & evidence: we’ll provide the redacted PDF (redwood-pt-2025-redacted.pdf) and a short evidence checklist. For your records I’m including a secure request form link: https://share.redwood.com/secure-request/abc123 — please expect the presigned URL to arrive separately once Ben provisions it.

4) If Acme prefers a data room instead (longer retention, role-based ACLs), we can arrange that but it typically takes 2 business days to provision.

Ben — can you please provision the presigned URL and ping Maria when it’s ready? I’ll follow up by calendar invite if Acme wants a 15-min review.

Thanks,
Vivek

Attachment: security-evidence-checklist.md
